Name: Ilucie's Adopt a Rock Crab
Author: IlucieYt
Description:
Now you are able to adopt cute, little Rock Crabs from Marnie as pets!

They come in different colors and forms:
- Violet Rock Crab
- Blue Rock Crab
- Green Rock Crab
- Pink Rock Crab with a white rock
- Shiny Rock Crab
- Dwarf Rock Crab which is smaller and... naked.

~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
This mod implements custom pets and doesn't replace existing files, so you can have your Rock Crab alongside your dogs, cats and turtles!
~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
